blocks.text: This installation uses one managed rootless devops Podman engine and a shared Unix API. Docker CLI and Compose use that API. It is not a second rootful Docker daemon. Follow the installed /data/docs/podman-devops.md guide for the selected host.

Access to the shared socket grants authority over that engine. Service ownership, storage and namespace networking are managed together. Existing stores must not be reset as a troubleshooting shortcut.

Use Computer Management → Containers & AI → Containers and the installed guide. Check whether the engine/socket is available before retrying a client operation. Preserve application volumes and any reported recovery directory.
Container prune, volume deletion, system reset and storage migration can destroy data. Help never runs containers or changes engine state.
